title: ObligationAcceptanceCredential
meaning: The holder's institution accepted obligations for a project, each for a dataset.
description: The obligations (such as collaboration or publication) the subject is bound by in a project; issuer claims the subject's institution accepted, for the subject's project, an agreement carrying each obligation for a dataset.

project.description: DID of the project the obligations apply to.

scopes.description: Every obligation accepted for the project.

dataset.description: DID of the dataset the obligation applies to.

agreement.description: DID of the agreement document that carries the obligation.
